title: Adjunction transfer of functorial injective embeddings
statement: Let $v:\mathcal D\to\mathcal M$ be a fully faithful functor between module categories that carries monomorphisms to monomorphisms and has a right adjoint $u:\mathcal M\to\mathcal D$. If $\mathcal M$ has functorial injective embeddings, then so does $\mathcal D$: a functorial embedding in $\mathcal M$ followed by $u$ gives a functor $J:\mathcal D\to\mathcal D$, and the adjunction supplies a natural monomorphism from each object to its image; each image is injective in $\mathcal D$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions].
